OBJECT Codeunit 50005 No With
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    PROCEDURE ProcessEntries@1(ItemNoP@1000 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      ItemLedgEntryL@1001 : Record 32;
      TotalQtyL@1002 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // CAL005: WITH must be removed and fields/methods qualified with ItemLedgEntryL.
      ItemLedgEntryL.SETRANGE("Item No.", ItemNoP);
      ItemLedgEntryL.SETRANGE(Open, TRUE);
      IF ItemLedgEntryL.FINDSET() THEN
        REPEAT
          TotalQtyL += ItemLedgEntryL.Quantity;
        UNTIL ItemLedgEntryL.NEXT() = 0;

      // CAL005: single-statement WITH
      TotalQtyL += ItemLedgEntryL."Remaining Quantity";

      MESSAGE('%1', TotalQtyL);
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
